_comment: Every menu page on the site is rendered from this file — edit here, run
tools/build.py, done. Item order is preserved as written.
PRICES: intentionally left null. The printed menu is the source of truth
for prices and none were supplied, so nothing here invents one. A null
price renders as a dashed $— placeholder that is impossible to miss.
"tags" is optional — use it for V, GF, spicy and so on.
cardImage / cardWhen / cardBlurb drive the menu cards on the Menus page
AND the teaser on the home page — one definition, two pages, so they
cannot drift apart. cardOrder sets the order they appear in.

lunch.title: Lunch
lunch.lede: The full lunch card, plus a $18.99 prix fixe Tuesday to Friday.
lunch.served: Lunch Tuesday to Saturday, 11 AM to 3 PM. Prix fixe is dine-in only, Tuesday to Friday.
lunch.footnote: Consumption of raw undercooked meat, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of food borne illness, especially if a prior medical condition is present. Please inform your server of any food allergies before ordering. Nuts, seeds and spices are used on premises. 20% gratuity will be added to parties of 6 or more. Please no substitutions.
